name: Development inventory (read-only)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  create:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/development_inventory.py'
      - 'tests/test_development_inventory.py'
      - 'scripts/development_inventory_delta.py'
      - 'tests/test_development_inventory_delta.py'
      - 'tests/test_inventory_delta_string_details.py'
      - 'scripts/pr_promotion_policy.py'
      - 'tests/test_pr_promotion_policy.py'
      - 'scripts/pr_promotion_review.py'
      - 'tests/test_pr_promotion_review.py'
      - 'scripts/pr_review_handoff.py'
      - 'tests/test_pr_review_handoff.py'
      - 'scripts/pr_approval_routing.py'
      - 'tests/test_pr_approval_routing.py'
      - 'scripts/vercel_build_guard.py'
      - 'tests/test_vercel_build_guard.py'
      - '.github/workflows/pr-promotion-review.yml'
      - 'scripts/development_ledger_proposal.py'
      - 'tests/test_development_ledger_proposal.py'
      - '.github/workflows/development-inventory.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 1 * * *'
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  issues: read
jobs:
  inventory:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Offline regression tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_development_inventory.py' -v
      - name: Offline delta regression tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_development_inventory_delta.py' -v
      - name: Branch SHA and PR metadata regression tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_inventory_delta_string_details.py' -v
      - name: PR promotion policy tests (review only)
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_pr_promotion_policy.py' -v
      - name: PR classification metadata tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_pr_promotion_review.py' -v
      - name: PR handoff report tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_pr_review_handoff.py' -v
      - name: PR approval routing regression tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_pr_approval_routing.py' -v
      - name: Vercel build guard offline tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_vercel_build_guard.py' -v
      - name: Offline ledger proposal tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_development_ledger_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Read-only inventory
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STALE_DAYS: '14'
        run: python3 scripts/development_inventory.py
      - name: Build maintainer PR handoff queue
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: python3 scripts/pr_review_handoff.py
      - name: Route open PRs for human review (read-only)
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/pr_approval_routing.py
      - name: Read-only change candidates
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/development_inventory_delta.py
      - name: Prepare review-only ledger proposal
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: python3 scripts/development_ledger_proposal.py
      - name: Save report artifact
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: development-inventory
          path: inventory-output/
          retention-days: 30

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Vercel Ignored Build Step: exit 0 to skip; exit 1 to build.

Never skip when prior deployment cannot be established or changes are unknown.
"""
import os
import subprocess

MANAGEMENT_FILES = {
    ".github/workflows/development-inventory.yml",
    ".github/workflows/pr-promotion-review.yml",
    ".github/workflows/ledger-facts-proposal.yml",
    "docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md",
    "docs/DEVELOPMENT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md",
    "docs/PR_PROMOTION_POLICY.md",
    "scripts/development_inventory.py",
    "scripts/development_inventory_delta.py",
    "scripts/development_ledger_proposal.py",
    "scripts/verify_ledger_proposal.py",
    "scripts/pr_promotion_policy.py",
    "scripts/pr_promotion_review.py",
    "scripts/pr_review_handoff.py",
    "scripts/pr_approval_routing.py",
    "tests/test_development_inventory.py",
    "tests/test_development_inventory_delta.py",
    "tests/test_development_ledger_proposal.py",
    "tests/test_inventory_delta_string_details.py",
    "tests/test_pr_promotion_policy.py",
    "tests/test_pr_promotion_review.py",
    "tests/test_pr_review_handoff.py",
    "tests/test_pr_approval_routing.py",
}

def may_skip(previous, git=subprocess.run):
    if not previous or len(previous) != 40 or any(ch not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for ch in previous):
        return False
    try:
        result = git(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", previous, "HEAD", "--"],
                     capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, check=False)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return False
    if result.returncode:
        return False
    paths = result.stdout.splitlines()
    return bool(paths) and all(path in MANAGEMENT_FILES for path in paths)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if may_skip(os.environ.get("VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA")):
        print("Skip build: verified management-only change.")
        raise SystemExit(0)
    print("Run build: application/unknown change or missing baseline.")
    raise SystemExit(1)

+import subprocess
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from scripts.vercel_build_guard import may_skip
+
+SHA = "a" * 40
+
+def changed(*paths, code=0):
+    return lambda *args, **kwargs: SimpleNamespace(returncode=code, stdout="\n".join(paths))
+
+class BuildGuardTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_management_only_skips(self):
+        self.assertTrue(may_skip(SHA, changed("docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md", "scripts/pr_approval_routing.py")))
+    def test_app_change_builds(self):
+        self.assertFalse(may_skip(SHA, changed("app/page.tsx")))
+    def test_mixed_change_builds(self):
+        self.assertFalse(may_skip(SHA, changed("docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md", "app/page.tsx")))
+    def test_unknown_code_builds(self):
+        self.assertFalse(may_skip(SHA, changed("scripts/notification.py")))
+    def test_missing_previous_builds(self):
+        self.assertFalse(may_skip("", changed("docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")))
+    def test_failed_git_builds(self):
+        self.assertFalse(may_skip(SHA, changed(code=128)))
+    def test_no_differences_builds(self):
+        self.assertFalse(may_skip(SHA, changed()))
+    def test_bad_sha_builds(self):
+        self.assertFalse(may_skip("not-a-sha", changed("docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")))
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

> **最新の交通整理表**：[開発案件・担当・次の一手の運用索引](DEVELOPMENT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md)（2026-11-01時点。実装・本番の完了認定ではない）。

> **このファイルは詳細台帳の代替ではない。** 2026-10-31時点の管理入口を追加するためのもの。実装・統合・本番反映を新たに認定しない。

[実装・修正総覧](IMPLEMENTATION_OVERVIEW.md) · [共通運用規約](DEVELOPMENT_MANAGEMENT_STANDARD.md)

## 既存棚卸しの正本

- 専用ブランチ: `docs/development-registry-audit-20261020`
- 詳細台帳: `docs/DEVELOPMENT_REGISTRY.md`（**この専用ブランチから取得すること**）
- 追加の監査資料: 同ブランチの `docs/audits/20261021-work-all-assets/` ほか。
- 継続更新規約: 同ブランチの `docs/development-ledger-continuous-update-rule-20261023.md`。
- 詳細台帳は2026-10-20開始の棚卸し途中の記録。記載の91ブランチは当時の調査母集団であり、現在の総数ではない。
- 専用ブランチはmainと分岐しており、監査ファイルや未公開実装が混在する可能性がある。**ブランチ全体をmainへマージしないこと。**

## 判定区分

A: main実装確認 / B: ブランチ実装・main未確認 / C: 実験・検証不足 / D: 設計・監査のみ / U: 未判定。

**Aも本番反映の保証ではない。** Preview・CI・過去のPR説明だけで本番状態を確定しない。

## 優先して照合する作業（過去の棚卸しに記録あり）

| 作業 | 過去記録の所在 | 次の確認 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Forget Control v1 | `work/forget-control-v1`, PR #66 | 現行main・関連migration・本番適用の実体を再照合 |
| Relationship Identity | PR #67、詳細台帳 | 保存・復元・migrationの実体と統合状態を再照合 |
| Conversation Lab | PR #86、詳細台帳 | 実験結果と本番利用の区別を確認 |
| 共通会話エンジン | PR #88、詳細台帳 | main依存経路と検証の実体を確認 |
| 美咲単独版入口・ラウンジ・チャット | 過去のローカルコミット `7f42677` | リモート存在、Preview、公開前レビューを確認。ここでは本番反映を認定しない |
| 全ブランチ棚卸し | `docs/development-registry-audit-20261020` | 最新ブランチ・open/closed PRと照合して追加分を分類 |

※ この表は既存資料への入口であり、最新実装の判定結果ではない。

## 自動棚卸し

- 実装案: `scripts/development_inventory.py`
- 週次ワークフロー案: `.github/workflows/development-inventory.yml`
- レポートは**未登録・放置の可能性を示す候補**。PRのないブランチを未完了と断定しない。
- 詳細は[共通運用規約](DEVELOPMENT_MANAGEMENT_STANDARD.md)を参照。

## 次の一手

1. 詳細台帳と全ブランチの最新head・PR状態を突き合わせ、前回棚卸し以降の変更を分類する。
2. 既存の詳細証拠を消さずに、作業ID／状態／証拠／未確認／次の一手の索引を拡充する。
3. 自動レポートの誤検知を検証し、ユーザー承認後にワークフローをmainへ統合する。

## 2026-11-01 差分棚卸しの起点（読み取り確認）

- GitHubブランチ検索で **109ブランチ（main含む）** を取得。過去の詳細台帳に記載された91ブランチは当時の母集団であり、差分の厳密な件数ではない。削除・改名・追加の可能性を区別してから照合する。
- 現行の新しい作業候補として `feat/lounge-chat-handoff-20261030`、`feat/lounge-opening-fullscreen-20261029`、`feat/lounge-muse-v3-official-20261030`、`fix/lounge-transition-flash-20261030`、`experiment/transparent-lounge-20261027` を確認。**ブランチ存在のみ確認済み、main統合・実機・本番は未判定（U）**。
- 既存の詳細台帳 `docs/DEVELOPMENT_REGISTRY.md` は専用ブランチのまま保持し、上記の新規候補との重複と証拠を確認してから索引へ正式登録する。
- 管理用PR #103 のオフライン回帰テストは2026-11-01確認時点で成功。これはGitHub実データ棚卸しの実行成功を意味しない。
- 次の一手：詳細台帳の記載済み作業IDと現在の109ブランチを照合し、追加・更新・所在不明を分類。ラウンジ系の詳細資料とPRを確認し、未確認項目を勝手に完了扱いしない。

## 2026-11-01 証拠付き作業索引（初回・暫定）

以下は作業単位の入口。2026-11-01のGitHub読み取り結果であり、状態の最終認定ではない。詳細は `docs/audits/DEVELOPMENT_INVENTORY_DIFF_20261101.md`。main・本番・DB・実機は個別の確認がない限り**未確認**。

| ID | 作業 | 状態 | 所在・証拠 | main / 本番 / 実機 | 次の一手 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M-LNG-01 | ラウンジ・オープニング・チャット遷移（関連ブランチを1作業群として管理） | C暫定 | `feat/lounge-chat-handoff-20261030`, `feat/lounge-opening-fullscreen-20261029`, `feat/lounge-muse-v3-official-20261030`, `fix/lounge-transition-flash-20261030`; `docs/LOUNGE_SHORTCUT_PREVIEW_20261030.md`, `docs/LOUNGE_VIDEO_INTEGRATION_LEDGER_20261029.md` | 未確認 / 未確認 / 未確認 | mainとの差分と素材・遷移を統合的に確認。既存チャットや本番を変更しない |
| M-MEM-01 | 匿名情報単位24時間記憶 | D | `design/anonymous-per-item-24h-memory-20261030`; `docs/ANONYMOUS_MEMORY_24H_DESIGN_20261030.md` | 未確認 / 未確認 / 未確認 | 実装着手時は時刻境界と既存記憶の互換を検証 |
| M-MEM-02 | 記憶の公開方針・台帳補足 | D暫定 | `docs/misaki-memory-public-final-20261030` | 未確認 / 未確認 / 未確認 | 既存詳細台帳との記載差分のみ照合 |
| M-CONV-01 | Conversation Lab | C暫定 | Draft PR #86（open、未マージ、2026-11-01確認） | 未確認 / 未確認 / 未確認 | 実験と本番採用を区別して検証 |
| M-CONV-02 | 共通会話エンジンの接続基盤 | C暫定 | Draft PR #88（open、未マージ、2026-11-01確認） | 未確認 / 未確認 / 未確認 | 現行mainの依存経路を検証 |

## 2026-11-01 既存詳細台帳との重複解消

- **M-CONV-01 / M-CONV-02は新規未完了作業ではなく、既存詳細台帳の既知案件。** `docs/development-registry-audit-20261020` 上の `docs/DEVELOPMENT_REGISTRY.md` にConversation Lab PR #86と共通会話エンジン PR #88の実装・検証・未採用理由が既に記録されている。今回の索引は**再調査の指示ではなく既存証拠への入口**として扱う。
- 2026-11-01時点でPR #86 / #88ともopen Draft・未マージ。詳細台帳にある過去のCI・Previewの成功は消さず、現在のmain/本番採用とは区別する。
- **M-LNG-01は複数の同一HTML変更を一作業群として管理。** 既存詳細台帳の2026-10-26静的ラウンジ試作とは時点・対象が異なるため、過去の記録を残したまま2026-10-29〜30の新しいブランチを追加証拠とする。
- `design/anonymous-per-item-24h-memory-20261030` は資料に**未実装**と明記。設計Dを維持し、匿名記憶の実装完了とは扱わない。

## 日次レポートと週次差分の確認手順
1. GitHub Actionsの `Development inventory (read-only)` の最新**成功**runを開き、`development-inventory` artifactの `report.json` / `summary.md` を取得する。失敗・未実行なら前回値を最新値と扱わず、実行日時を明記する。
2. 前回の成功runと比較する対象は、ブランチの追加・消滅・head変化、PRの新規・open/closed/merged変化、Issueの新規・状態変化、長期停滞候補の増減。**集計件数の差だけで作業完了・未統合・削除可能とは判断しない**。
3. 変化を見つけたら、対応する案件IDと証拠（PR・commit・ブランチ・run ID）を照合する。新規案件だけIDを追加し、既存案件は状態・次の一手・確認日を更新する。変更なしなら台帳の不要な書き換えはしない。
4. 旧ブランチの保全・削除判断、アプリ実装、DB、Push、本番変更は担当者と別途判断する。週次差分確認は**手順の定義のみ**で、現時点で自動実行されない。

### 更新時の最小記録
`確認日（JST） / 案件ID / 変更前→変更後 / 証拠URL・run ID / 引継ぎ先 / 次の一手 / 未確認事項`。

## 第4段階：台帳の安全な自動更新（導入前の運用契約）

- **事実ログと判断欄を分離する。** GitHub APIで確認できたPR番号・タイトル・状態・head SHA・更新日時・証拠URLのみを、機械管理の独立セクションへ追記する。開発案件の進捗、完了、本番稼働、実機確認、担当者の判断欄は変更しない。
- **PR方式を優先する。** 自動化は専用ブランチ上に更新案を生成し、差分がある場合のみ台帳更新PRを作る。初期段階は自動マージせず、実データの正確性と重複防止を確認してから限定的な自動マージを検討する。
- **証拠が不足する場合は更新しない。** 比較不能、API失敗、分類の曖昧さ、100件を超えるファイル一覧、既存台帳との競合は確認待ちとして記録する。PRマージだけで開発完了と判断しない。
- **冪等性。** PR番号とhead SHAなどの安定した識別子を使い、再実行しても同じ事実を重複追記しない。自動化自身のPRは製品開発案件へ割り当てない。
- **安全境界。** アプリコード、DB、認証、Push、デプロイ、ブランチ削除は操作しない。GitHub Actionsの書込権限は台帳更新専用ジョブに限定し、既存のread-only棚卸しは維持する。

この節は設計合意の記録であり、台帳の自動書込みが稼働していることを意味しない。

# PRのmain昇格ルール（初期導入：判定のみ）

## 原則
- 作業ブランチ → PR → CI → 変更分類 → 必要な承認 → main。
- **初期段階は自動マージを無効**。分類結果はレビューの補助情報であり、承認・デプロイではない。
- Draft、変更ファイル一覧の欠落・不完全、未知の変更は自動昇格しない。
- 本体・認証・DB・通知・セッション・デプロイに関係する変更はユーザー承認を要する。
- 管理用スクリプト、CI、ポリシー自身の変更は担当ソラの確認が必要で、自己承認禁止。
- 台帳は人が書いた領域を保護し、機械管理欄の差分が検証できるまで自動昇格禁止。
- GitHubの必須チェック・ブランチ保護・レビュー条件は迂回しない。
- **mainマージと本番デプロイは別の承認対象**。Git連携で自動配備される構成は特に注意。
- 追加のAI API・常駐サービスを使わない。既存Actionsの範囲内で検証する。

## 担当
- GitHub Actions: 機械的な事実・CI・分類。
- プロジェクト担当ソラ: 判断待ちPRの内容・影響を確認し、ユーザーへ報告。
- 自動化担当ソラ: 両リポジトリの分類規則・棚卸し・回帰テストを管理。
- ユーザー: 高リスク変更と例外の最終承認。

## 次の段階に進む条件
実PRで誤分類がないことを確認し、必要なブランチ保護・必須CI・権限・Actions利用枠を検証してから、
**別途ユーザー承認を得て**限定的な自動マージを有効にする。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only GitHub development inventory. No branch/PR/Issue mutations."""
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

REPO = os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"]
TOKEN = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
NOW = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
STALE_DAYS = int(os.environ.get("STALE_DAYS", "14"))
API = "https://api.github.com"

def get(path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + path, headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN,
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        "User-Agent": "development-inventory-readonly",
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)

def pages(path):
    result = []
    page = 1
    while True:
        separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
        batch = get(path + separator + "per_page=100&page=" + str(page))
        if not isinstance(batch, list):
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected API response")
        result.extend(batch)
        if len(batch) < 100:
            return result
        page += 1

def age(timestamp):
    if not timestamp:
        return None
    updated = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return (NOW - updated).days

def main():
    repo = urllib.parse.quote(REPO, safe="/")
    metadata = get("/repos/" + repo)
    default = metadata["default_branch"]
    branches = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/branches")
    all_prs = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/pulls?state=all")
    prs = [p for p in all_prs if p["state"] == "open"]
    issues = [item for item in pages("/repos/" + repo + "/issues?state=open") if "pull_request" not in item]
    pr_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    historical_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in all_prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    findings = []
    for branch in branches:
        name = branch["name"]
        if name == default:
            continue
        # No-PR does NOT mean unfinished. Report only as a review candidate.
        if name not in pr_heads:
            findings.append({"type": "branch_without_open_pr", "name": name,
                             "historical_pr_found": name in historical_heads,
                             "url": "https://github.com/" + REPO + "/tree/" + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe="")})
    stale_prs = [{"number": p["number"], "title": p["title"], "days": age(p["updated_at"]),
                  "url": p["html_url"]} for p in prs if age(p["updated_at"]) is not None and age(p["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    stale_issues = [{"number": i["number"], "title": i["title"], "days": age(i["updated_at"]),
                     "url": i["html_url"]} for i in issues if age(i["updated_at"]) is not None and age(i["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    report = {"repository": REPO, "generated_at": NOW.isoformat(), "default_branch": default,
              "branch_count": len(branches), "open_pr_count": len(prs),
              "open_issue_count": len(issues), "historical_pr_count": len(all_prs), "review_candidates": findings,
              "stale_prs": stale_prs, "stale_issues": stale_issues,
              "caveat": "Candidates are NOT proof of unfinished work. Compare main, merged/closed PRs, and canonical ledger before action."}
    # Stable snapshot for comparison across successful scheduled/manual runs.
    report["snapshot"] = {
        "branches": {b["name"]: b.get("commit", {}).get("sha") for b in branches},
        "prs": {str(p["number"]): {"state": ("merged" if p.get("merged_at") else p["state"]),
                                  "head": p["head"].get("sha"), "updated_at": p["updated_at"],
                                  "title": p.get("title", ""), "body": (p.get("body") or "")[:2000],
                                  "head_ref": p["head"].get("ref", "")}
                for p in all_prs},
        "issues": {str(i["number"]): {"state": "open", "updated_at": i["updated_at"]} for i in issues},
    }
    os.makedirs("inventory-output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("inventory-output/report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    summary = ["# Development inventory (read-only)", "",
               "Repository: " + REPO, "Generated (UTC): " + NOW.isoformat(), "",
               "| Metric | Count |", "|---|---:|",
               "| Branches including default | " + str(len(branches)) + " |",
               "| Open PRs | " + str(len(prs)) + " |",
               "| Open issues | " + str(len(issues)) + " |",
               "| Branches without open PR (review only) | " + str(len(findings)) + " |",
               "| Stale PRs (>= " + str(STALE_DAYS) + " days) | " + str(len(stale_prs)) + " |",
               "| Stale issues | " + str(len(stale_issues)) + " |", "",
               "**Do not mark branches unfinished or delete them based on this report.**",
               "Consult the project's canonical ledger, closed/merged PRs and main code first.", "",
               "## Stale PRs"]
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(p["number"]) + "](" + p["url"] + ") (" + str(p["days"]) + "d): " + p["title"].replace("\n", " ") for p in stale_prs)
    summary.append("\n## Stale issues")
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(i["number"]) + "](" + i["url"] + ") (" + str(i["days"]) + "d): " + i["title"].replace("\n", " ") for i in stale_issues)
    summary.append("\nBranch candidates are available in report.json artifact.")
    text = "\n".join(summary) + "\n"
    with open("inventory-output/summary.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/null"), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    print(text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (urllib.error.URLError, KeyError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print("Inventory failed: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a deterministic, review-only GitHub facts section from inventory report."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

START = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_START -->"
END = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_END -->"

def render(report):
    prs = report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs", {})
    lines = ["## GitHub自動取得の事実（確認用）", "",
             "> この欄はPRメタデータの記録であり、開発完了・本番反映の認定ではありません。", "",
             "| PR | タイトル | 状態 | head SHA | 更新日時 |",
             "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]) if str(item[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict):
            continue
        if str(pr.get("head_ref", "")).startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"):
            continue
        state = str(pr.get("state", "unknown")).replace("|", "/").replace("\n", " ")
        sha = str(pr.get("head", ""))[:40]
        updated = str(pr.get("updated_at", ""))[:35]
        title = " ".join(str(pr.get("title", "")).split()).replace("|", "/")[:120]
        lines.append(f"| #{number} | {title} | {state} | `{sha}` | {updated} |")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def update(ledger, report):
    section = START + "\n" + render(report) + END
    if START in ledger or END in ledger:
        if ledger.count(START) != 1 or ledger.count(END) != 1 or ledger.index(START) > ledger.index(END):
            raise ValueError("Invalid managed markers; refuse to change ledger")
        return ledger[:ledger.index(START)] + section + ledger[ledger.index(END) + len(END):]
    return ledger.rstrip() + "\n\n" + section + "\n"

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--report", default="inventory-output/report.json")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", default="docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = json.loads(Path(args.report).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs"), dict):
        raise ValueError("PR snapshot missing; refuse to propose ledger update")
    proposed = update(Path(args.ledger).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), report)
    target = Path(args.output)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(proposed, encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Enrich the existing PR handoff queue with fail-closed approval routing.

Read-only. Decisions are advisory, never proof of review or approval.
"""
import json
import os
import urllib.error
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from scripts.pr_promotion_review import inspect
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    from pr_promotion_review import inspect

ROUTES = {
    "owner_approval_required": "ユーザー承認が必要（担当ソラが先に内容確認）",
    "maintainer_review_required": "担当ソラの確認が必要",
    "hold_draft": "Draftのため保留",
    "hold_incomplete": "情報不足のため保留",
    "hold_invalid": "判定不可のため保留",
}


def clean(value, limit=120):
    return " ".join(str(value).split()).replace("|", "/").replace("[", "(").replace("]", ")")[:limit]


def build(report, inspect_pr=inspect):
    repo = report.get("repository")
    snapshot = report.get("snapshot")
    prs = snapshot.get("prs") if isinstance(snapshot, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(repo, str) or not repo or not isinstance(prs, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing repository or PR snapshot")
    rows = []
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda pair: int(pair[0]) if str(pair[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict) or pr.get("state") != "open":
            continue
        try:
            classification = inspect_pr(repo, int(number))
            decision = classification.get("decision")
            if decision not in ROUTES:
                decision = "hold_invalid"
                reason = "Unknown classifier result"
            elif classification.get("head_sha") != pr.get("head"):
                decision = "hold_incomplete"
                reason = "PR changed during inventory; recheck required"
            else:
                reason = classification.get("reason", "")
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, TimeoutError) as error:
            decision = "hold_incomplete"
            reason = "PR classification unavailable: " + type(error).__name__
        rows.append({"number": int(number), "title": clean(pr.get("title", "")),
                     "updated_at": clean(pr.get("updated_at", ""), 35),
                     "decision": decision, "route": ROUTES[decision], "reason": clean(reason, 180),
                     "head_sha": pr.get("head")})
    return rows


def render(repo, rows):
    lines = [
        "# PR確認待ち・承認経路（読み取り専用）", "",
        "これは担当ソラ向けの確認キューです。判定はファイル名等に基づく保守的な一次分類で、承認・実機確認・本番反映を意味しません。",
        "ユーザー承認が必要なPRは、担当ソラが変更内容・CI・本番影響を確認してからユーザーへ相談してください。", "",
        "| PR | タイトル | 次の確認者 | 判定 | 更新日時 |",
        "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
    ]
    for row in rows:
        lines.append(
            f"| [#{row['number']}](https://github.com/{repo}/pull/{row['number']})"
            f" | {row['title']} | {row['route']} | \`{row['decision']}\` | {row['updated_at']} |"
        )
    if not rows:
        lines.append("| — | Open PRなし | — | — | — |")
    lines.extend(["", f"Open PR: {len(rows)}", "",
                  "自動承認・自動マージ・自動通知は行いません。保留も担当ソラが原因を確認してください。"])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def main():
    report = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = build(report)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a read-only handoff queue for project maintainers from inventory."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

def render(report):
    repo = report.get("repository", "")
    snapshot = report.get("snapshot")
    prs = snapshot.get("prs") if isinstance(snapshot, dict) else None
    if not repo or not isinstance(prs, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing repository or PR snapshot")
    lines = ["# 担当ソラへのPR確認待ち一覧", "",
             "この一覧はGitHubのPR状態を記録したものです。安全性や完了を認定しません。",
             "担当ソラは各PRの変更内容・CI・本番影響を確認してください。",
             "ユーザー承認が必要な変更は承認前にmainへ統合しないでください。", "",
             "| PR | タイトル | 状態 | 最終更新 |",
             "| --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    count = 0
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]) if str(item[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict) or pr.get("state") != "open":
            continue
        title = " ".join(str(pr.get("title", "")).split()).replace("|", "/").replace("[", "(").replace("]", ")")[:120]
        date = str(pr.get("updated_at", ""))[:35]
        lines.append(f"| [#{number}](https://github.com/{repo}/pull/{number}) | {title} | 確認待ち（Draft含む可能性） | {date} |")
        count += 1
    if not count:
        lines.append("| — | 現時点でopen PRなし | — | — |")
    lines.extend(["", f"Open PR: {count}", "",
                  "この一覧は自動承認・自動マージ・担当ソラへのプッシュ通知を行いません。"])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def main():
    report = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    output = Path("inventory-output/pr-review-handoff.md")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    result = render(report)
    output.write_text(result, encoding="utf-8")
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Offline tests for the read-only inventory; no GitHub token or network required."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

SCRIPT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "development_inventory.py"
os.environ.update(GITHUB_REPOSITORY="example/demo")
os.environ.setdefault("GITHUB_TOKEN", "offline-test-token")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("development_inventory", SCRIPT)
inventory = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(inventory)

class InventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_age_and_missing(self):
        self.assertIsNone(inventory.age(None))
        self.assertEqual(inventory.age(inventory.NOW.isoformat()), 0)

    def test_pagination(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            return [{"name": str(i)} for i in range(100)] if path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1] == "1" else [{"name": "last"}]
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/branches")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)

    def test_pagination_multiple_full_pages(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            page = int(path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1])
            if page <= 2:
                return [{"name": "branch-%s-%s" % (page, i)} for i in range(100)]
            return [{"name": "branch-last"}]
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/pulls?state=all")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 201)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 3)
        self.assertTrue(all("state=all" in path for path in calls))
        self.assertEqual(result[-1]["name"], "branch-last")

    def test_empty_page_terminates_pagination(self):
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value=[]) as fake_get:
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open")
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        fake_get.assert_called_once_with("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open&per_page=100&page=1")

    def test_pr_and_issue_pagination_are_independent(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            page = int(path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1])
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 101}]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 102}]
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            prs = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/pulls?state=all")
            issues = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open")
        self.assertEqual(len(prs), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 4)

    def test_closed_pr_history_is_retained(self):
        old = "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
        closed = {"number": 8, "state": "closed", "title": "Done",
                  "updated_at": old, "html_url": "https://github.com/example/demo/pull/8",
                  "head": {"ref": "feature/done", "repo": {"full_name": "example/demo"}}}
        def fake_pages(path):
            if "/branches" in path:
                return [{"name": "main"}, {"name": "feature/done"}]
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [closed]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return []
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            current = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value={"default_branch": "main"}), patch.object(inventory, "pages", side_effect=fake_pages):
                    inventory.main()
                with open("inventory-output/report.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    result = json.load(f)
            finally:
                os.chdir(current)
        self.assertEqual(result["open_pr_count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["historical_pr_count"], 1)
        self.assertTrue(result["review_candidates"][0]["historical_pr_found"])

    def test_report_candidates_are_not_completion_claims(self):
        old = "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
        recent = inventory.NOW.isoformat()
        pr = {"number": 12, "state": "open", "title": "Open PR", "updated_at": old,
              "html_url": "https://github.com/example/demo/pull/12",
              "head": {"ref": "feature/open", "repo": {"full_name": "example/demo"}}}
        issue = {"number": 13, "title": "Open issue", "updated_at": recent,
                 "html_url": "https://github.com/example/demo/issues/13"}
        def fake_pages(path):
            if "/branches" in path:
                return [{"name": "main"}, {"name": "feature/open"}, {"name": "research/archive"}]
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [pr]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return [issue, {"pull_request": {}, **issue}]
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            current = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value={"default_branch": "main"}), patch.object(inventory, "pages", side_effect=fake_pages):
                    inventory.main()
                with open("inventory-output/report.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    result = json.load(f)
            finally:
                os.chdir(current)
        self.assertEqual(result["branch_count"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(result["open_issue_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual([x["name"] for x in result["review_candidates"]], ["research/archive"])
        self.assertEqual(len(result["stale_prs"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["stale_issues"]), 0)
        self.assertIn("NOT proof", result["caveat"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import json
import os
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import scripts.development_inventory_delta as delta
from scripts.development_inventory_delta import compare

class DeltaTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_changes_and_unchanged(self):
        old = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "a", "old": "x"}, "prs": {"1": {"state": "open"}}, "issues": {}}}
        new = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "a", "new": "y"}, "prs": {"1": {"state": "merged"}}, "issues": {"2": {"state": "open"}}}}
        changes = compare(old, new)
        self.assertEqual(len(changes), 4)
        self.assertEqual({(x["type"], x["id"], x["change"]) for x in changes},
                         {("branches", "old", "absent_from_snapshot"),
                          ("branches", "new", "added"),
                          ("prs", "1", "changed"),
                          ("issues", "2", "added")})

    def test_http_401_preserves_report_and_marks_delta_unavailable(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            cwd = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                Path("inventory-output").mkdir()
                Path("inventory-output/report.json").write_text(
                    json.dumps({"snapshot": {"branches": {}, "prs": {}, "issues": {}}}))
                with patch.object(delta, "previous_snapshot",
                                  side_effect=urllib.error.HTTPError("test", 401, "Unauthorized", {}, None)):
                    delta.main()
                result = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/delta.json").read_text())
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], "comparison_unavailable")
                self.assertIn("401", result["note"])
                self.assertTrue(Path("inventory-output/report.json").exists())
            finally:
                os.chdir(cwd)

    def test_cross_host_redirect_does_not_forward_token(self):
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            "https://api.github.com/repos/example/demo/actions/artifacts/123/zip",
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer test-secret"})
        handler = delta.SafeRedirect()
        redirected = handler.redirect_request(
            req, None, 302, "Found", {},
            "https://artifact-storage.example.test/file.zip?sig=dummy")
        self.assertIsNotNone(redirected)
        self.assertNotIn("Authorization", redirected.headers)
        self.assertNotIn("Authorization", redirected.unredirected_hdrs)

    def test_triage_does_not_assign_completion(self):
        changes = [{"type": "branches", "id": "feature/new-thing", "change": "added"}]
        with patch.object(delta, "api", return_value=[]):
            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | 進行中 |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["classification"], "needs_review")
        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")

    def test_pr_title_matches_index_without_status_change(self):
        changes = [{"type": "prs", "id": "123", "change": "added",
                    "after": {"title": "ラウンジ", "body": "", "head_ref": "feature"}}]
        suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | 進行中 |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["candidate_case_ids"], ["M-01"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")
        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])

    def test_inventory_maintenance_is_not_product_case(self):
        changes = [{"type": "prs", "id": "44", "change": "added",
                    "after": {"title": "inventory triage", "body": "", "head_ref": "fix"}}]
        with patch.object(delta, "api", return_value=[{"filename": "scripts/development_inventory_delta.py"}]):
            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | x |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["classification"], "automation_maintenance")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["candidate_case_ids"], [])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["file_evidence"]["status"], "complete")

    def test_file_evidence_does_not_change_ledger(self):
        changes = [{"type": "prs", "id": "45", "change": "added", "after": {}}]
        with patch.object(delta, "api", return_value=[{"filename": "src/lounge/ui.ts"}]):
            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | x |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")
        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["file_evidence"]["paths"], ["src/lounge/ui.ts"])

    def test_identical(self):
        snapshot = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "x"}, "prs": {}, "issues": {}}}
        self.assertEqual(compare(snapshot, snapshot), [])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
